prompt_texts.head:
You are rating one street corner for curb ramps, as a human rater does in a gallery. The rubric the human rater follows is below, verbatim.

<rubric>
{rubric}</rubric>
prompt_texts.multi: Rate corner {corner} of this unit only. The first image is the aerial: north up, about 70 m across. The solid white lines are the unit's legs, dashed white lines (if any) are phantom legs, the dashed white circle is the 30 m window, and each numbered white circle is a corner marker; corner {corner} is the one with the thick blue outline. The yellow numbered dots are the cameras of the crops that follow, each joined to corner {corner} by a dashed yellow line. Then come {n} crop(s) of street-level panoramas, each centred on corner {corner}'s corner point (the orange ring).
prompt_texts.noaerial: Rate corner {corner} of this unit only. No aerial is given. The images are {n} crop(s) of street-level panoramas, each centred on corner {corner}'s corner point (the orange ring).
prompt_texts.single: Rate corner {corner} of this unit only, from the one crop below; no aerial and no other crop is given. It is a crop of a street-level panorama centred on corner {corner}'s corner point (the orange ring).
prompt_texts.caption: Crop {i}: captured {date}, camera {dist:.1f} m from the corner point.
prompt_texts.tail: The city inventory is not available. Answer in JSON: `verdict` is present, absent or cant_tell; `absent_kind` is curb_no_ramp, no_sidewalk or unspecified when the verdict is absent, and null otherwise.
